guards: The live preview may render partial UI states but partial preview is not a workflow approval state.
HUMAN_APPROVED is valid only for the exact current payload_hash + render_hash pair.
Any contract-affecting input mutation before external write invalidates HUMAN_APPROVED.
No transition to an external-write state before HUMAN_APPROVED and PDF_READY.
The review confirmation action itself performs no external write.
MANUAL_REQUIRED can never transition to RENDERED automatically.
Every external write requires idempotency key and explicit confirmation in LIVE.
After an external write, existing external records/documents are immutable from ordinary form edits; a change requires explicit new revision/version workflow.
Automated tests may only use MOCK transitions for external-write states.
